listen_address.description: IP address E2Guardian listens on for incoming HTTP proxy requests.

listen_port.description: Port number E2Guardian listens on (typically 8080 or 3128).

tls_listen_port.description: Port for TLS proxy traffic (typically 8090). Set to 0 to disable.

icap_port.description: Port for ICAP server mode. Set to 0 to disable.

transparent_http_port.description: Port for transparent HTTPS. Set to 0 to disable.

filter_groups.description: Number of filter groups (1 or more).

default_filter_group.description: Default filter group for explicit proxy mode.

enable_ssl.description: Enable SSL support. Must be 'on' or 'off'.

default_icap_filter_group.description: Default filter group for ICAP mode.

default_transparent_filter_group.description: Default filter group for transparent proxy mode.

reverse_client_ip_lookups.description: Perform reverse lookups for banned/exception IP clients. on|off.

log_exception_hits.description: Log exception hits: 0=never, 1=log without marking, 2=always mark.

show_weighted_found.description: Show weighted phrases found in logs. on|off.

log_client_name_and_ip.description: Log both hostname and IP. Applies to log formats 5,6,7,8.

dstats_interval.description: Interval in seconds between dynamic stats output. Min 10, max 3600.

reverse_address_lookups.description: Reverse lookups for site/URL lists. on|off.

search_sitelist_for_ip.description: Search sitelist for IP entries. on|off.

use_x_forwarded_for.description: Use X-Forwarded-For header for client IP. on|off.

force_quick_search.description: Force Quick Search rather than DFA search algorithm. on|off.
